versions.content: Additional PathHistory elements may be present in the DENM traces. However, unlike the first element, these shall describe alternative routes to the event location. These routes may or may not be available at the time of detecting the event. In the alternative routes, the PathPoints shall be position-ordered (i.e. shortest-path routes) and they shall not include the PathDeltaTime.
